comments.alligatoralley: Encouraging debut for this stable on reappearance; fair chance he'll build on that
comments.arecibo: Hasn't won since 2021 but went close in C&D Class 2 on last season's reappearance
comments.castan: Has a win and a nose second from his two starts over C&D; could bounce back to form
comments.catchcunningham: Raced too freely from wide draw when well beaten at Wolverhampton latest; earlier in form
comments.classyal: Not straightforward but he was third in this race on last season's reappearance
comments.eternalsunshine: Five wins in lower classes, including C&D last summer; can build on reappearance run
comments.gloryhyde: Won two Class 5 handicaps last term; pleasing return; still, needs to run as well as ever
comments.goldenrainbow: Eight wins but the last seven have come at Class 6 level; bit more needed than of late
comments.knicks: Form contender, although may not want the ground to dry out much
comments.moonflight: Off same mark as Ayr Class 4 win (5f, good to firm) last June; encouragement latest
comments.onlyspoofing: Irish-trained runner whose last three wins have come over C&D, latest 2023
comments.stashthecash: Three wins last year, including on reappearance, but they came on slow going
comments.sugarbaby: Has won over C&D but all five of his victories have come in Class 6 handicaps
comments.waterofleith: Hold-up horse who needs things to drop right and has a good jockey for that in D Tudhope
comments.zarzyni: Last two wins gained over C&D, the most recent in September (good ground); contender
comments.ziggysqueen: Sole win came over C&D as a 2yo; has had a breathing operation since last seen
